common_prompt_spec: Use case: stylized-concept. Premium tabletop marble puzzle asset, cream marble / polished brass / dark green felt art direction. Isolated top-down view, warm upper-left window light, soft contact shadows. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No text, labels, logos or watermarks.
export: Crop transparent padding using alpha > 64 for content bounds, preserve RGBA alpha, resize to wireframe dimensions. Pack ice fragments separately into four equal 60x44 cells.

assets.prompt_spec: Vertical U-shaped smooth terracotta clay channel liner, 124 by 340 game units, open top, rounded semicircle bottom, subtle hand-pressed fingerprints, darker raised edges and softly shaded inner wall. No arrows or marbles.
Four-row vertical U-shaped smooth terracotta clay channel liner, 124 by 450 game units, open top, rounded semicircle bottom, subtle fingerprints, darker raised edges. No arrows or marbles.
Small terracotta funnel lip seen from above, trapezoid narrowing downward, three embossed downward chevrons made of lighter clay, rounded outer shoulders, subtle fired-clay texture.
Left half of a polished brass sliding gate, horizontal bar, rounded outer left end, flat inner right end joining the mirrored half, engraved grip lines, warm gold highlights, subtle dark edge.
Round open-state enamel badge, polished brass rim, deep emerald green enamel center, clean raised ivory check mark, subtle bevel and glossy highlights.
Round closed-state enamel badge, polished brass rim, rich red enamel center, clean raised ivory cross mark, subtle bevel and glossy highlights.

Rounded square ice cube frame with frosty white beveled edges and 24px game-unit corners. Genuinely transparent center so the colored marble remains visible; thin rim cracks, cold blue rim light. No marble or snowflake badge.
Round blue enamel frozen-state badge, frosty white rim, crisp white six-point snowflake, subtly beveled glass, cool blue highlights with warm tabletop edge.
Exactly four distinct blue-white ice fragments in a horizontal row, clear glass-like ice, sharp polygonal edges, internal refraction, no overlap; one fragment per equal cell.

Two-part tutorial illustration: left glossy marble entering terracotta U-channel with bold green down arrow; right same marble blocked from exiting upward with red cross. Balanced readable small-size composition, symbols only.
Tutorial illustration of the same felt slot side by side: left brass gate halves pulled outward, green check; right gate halves joined at center, red cross. Subtle two-way arrow between states.

Horizontal tutorial sequence: frozen glossy marble inside ice frame with blue snowflake; green check and a single completed slot cue; same free marble with eight flying ice shards. Connect stages with subtle arrows. Symbols only.

assets.export: Original RGBA image copied without modifications; aspect ratio preserved with object-fit: contain.
